expected_result: A validation error message "Please fill all required fields." is displayed below the Service Report Name field and form submission is blocked.

description: Ensure special characters and SQL injection attempts are sanitized in text fields.
steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Enter special characters and SQL injection code in the Service Report Name field.
expected_result: The form is submitted, and the Service Report Name is displayed as plain text without executing any code. No harmful code is executed and the SR is created with the literal input as its name.

Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Fill in all required fields and submit the form.
Use the browser back button to return to the form.
Use the browser forward button to navigate away.
expected_result: Navigating back to the form after submission does not resubmit the form. The form is either cleared or disabled, and no duplicate SR is created.

title: Re-submission of the same form without refreshing

steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Fill in all required fields and submit the form.
Attempt to submit the form again without refreshing.
expected_result: Attempting to submit the form again without refreshing is prevented. The Save button is disabled or a message indicates the form has already been submitted.

title: Concurrent form submissions by two users
description: Ensure concurrent form submissions by two users result in unique SR numbers.
steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role on two different devices.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form on both devices.
Fill in all required fields on both devices.
Submit the form simultaneously on both devices.
expected_result: Each submission results in a unique SR number.

sessions.expected_result: A new Service Report is created with a unique SR number (e.g., SR0726100XXX).
A new Service Report is created with a different unique SR number (e.g., SR0726100YYY).

expected_result: The SR is not visible to the Customer User when Internal Only is toggled on.

sessions.expected_result: A new Service Report is created with Internal Only enabled.
The newly created Service Report is not visible in the list or detail view for the Customer User.

description: Verify that an agent who is the assignee of the ticket, but not in the ticket's department, can fetch service report form options.
preconditions: Agent is logged in
A ticket exists where the agent is the assignee but not in the ticket's department
steps_summary: Call the /reports/form/options endpoint with the ticket_id of the ticket where the agent is the assignee
expected_result: The API returns the eligible service report form options for the ticket's service type.
